pr.title: Tighten the band's pull request lines and drawers
pr.head: 2d091db6877ec967983cab3eb8fdbb33ce5e1c69

summary: Projector's band is the panel above the Claude Code prompt that lists the pull requests your review and fix loops track, and the questions and notices agents left in your inbox. Clicking a pull request's number, or an inbox item, opens a drawer under it: a few extra lines of facts and actions such as github, discuss, and dismiss.
This pull request makes three small fixes the owner asked for after using the band:

1. A pull request's drawer starts under its state. Each pull request row reads #258 draft title …. The drawer used to start in the row's first column, under the number, so its lines looked like rows of their own. It now starts one column past the number, under draft or ready, so it reads as part of the pull request above it.
  2. Replying to a notice closes its drawer. A notice is an inbox item an agent posts for you to read, with nothing to answer. Its drawer's discuss button puts the notice's subject, in quotes, in the prompt. Sending a prompt that answers a question already closed that question's drawer, but sending a reply that quotes a notice left the notice's drawer open over the band. Now that reply closes the drawer too. The reply still records nothing, and the notice stays in the band until you dismiss it.
  3. Open review threads show as a count. A pull request's line spelled out its unresolved review threads as "5 open threads", which crowded the line. It now shows a yellow ⋮5, the last note before the age.

All three changes live in hooks/register.tsx, the hooks module that draws the band and watches sent prompts. Tests in hooks/band.test.tsx cover each, and docs/plugins.md and the inbox plan describe all three.

groups.title: The band's drawers
groups.kicker: Where a pull request's drawer starts, how its line shows open threads, and which sent prompts close a notice's drawer.
intro: Each pull request row is a flex row of columns with a one-column gap between them: the label (the number, such as #258, as wide as the widest label shown), then the state, draft or ready, then the author and title. The drawer now has a left margin of labelWidth + 1, the label column plus that gap, so its first column is the state's.

Each pull request line ends with short notes before its age, such as conflict or changes requested, joined by · . notesOf builds them. The open review threads' count is now the last note, written ⋮5 in the warning color, so it sits beside the age.

The prompt.submit handler reads every prompt you send. It finds the questions the prompt answers with answersIn, records those answers, and closes their drawers once the prompt has entered the conversation. The handler now also lists this session's notices whose quoted subject appears in the prompt, and closes their drawers at the same moment. Only a prompt you send at the terminal or through Remote Control counts, as before; an agent's message or a notification that quotes a notice closes nothing.

files.note: The prompt handler closes a quoted notice's drawer, the pull request drawer gets a left margin, and the thread count becomes the last note.

checks.text: drawRow is the only caller of notesOf, and nothing else in hooks/, site/src/, src/, or skills/ matches the old "open thread" text. Checked by searching the repository.

mine now holds every item of this session, not only questions, but answersIn still keeps only open questions itself, and gets an empty list for a prompt you did not send, as before. So the set of answered questions is unchanged. Checked by reading answersIn in hooks/inbox.ts, and the 78 plugin tests pass.
A notice matches when its quoted subject appears anywhere in the prompt. A question's answer needs the quote to end its line, but a notice takes no answer, so any mention of it is a reply.

The notice drawers close only when the prompt entered (entered.drop is unset), the same condition that closes an answered question's drawer. closeDrawer changes nothing unless that item's drawer is the open one.
labelWidth + 1 matches the row above: its label Box has width={labelWidth} and the row has columnGap={1}.

groups.title: Tests
groups.kicker: Tests for each change, each failing on the code before it.
intro: The band's tests mount the band in a simulated Claude Code session, press its buttons, send prompts, and inspect the rendered tree.

checks.text: All 78 plugin tests pass at this head. With hooks/register.tsx from the base, the drawer and notice tests fail. With it from 3f853d8, the two tests that check the thread count fail.

files.note: The line test expects a yellow ⋮1, the drawer test expects a margin of 4 and the count after conflict, and the notice test expects the drawer closed after a reply.

checks.text: The count renders as · ⋮2 because each note after the first carries the separator in its own text.
The fixture's labels are r#1 and y#7, three columns each, so the margin is 3 plus the one-column gap.
The drawer's discuss button is gone, so the drawer closed, while the next line shows the notice still listed.
